title: Web workspace and members management
goal: Workspace owners and admins can create and manage workspaces, members, roles, projects and workspace policies from the web app, with every control matching the CT-RBAC matrix and every denial handled gracefully.
scope_in: Routes in apps/web/src/workspace/: `/workspaces` (list/create), `/w/:wsp` (overview), `/w/:wsp/members`, `/w/:wsp/projects`, `/w/:wsp/settings` using GET/POST /v1/workspaces, GET/PATCH /v1/workspaces/{id}, members endpoints, projects endpoints, settings endpoints.

Members table (DESIGN.md 10.2.9): name, role chip (owner, admin, member, billing, guest), joined date; actions change role (PATCH /v1/workspaces/{id}/members/{mem}), remove/leave (DELETE), transfer ownership (POST .../transfer-ownership) with typed confirmation.

Invite management list and create dialog (email or link, role, seat check) calling GET/POST /v1/workspaces/{id}/invites and DELETE /v1/invites/{id}; Idempotency-Key on every create (required for invites).

Workspace settings form: rename, default auto-approve (`ask|trusted|everyone` mirroring control.policy values), history sharing, retention override via GET/PATCH /v1/workspaces/{id}/settings with `If-Match` ETag handling.
Role-aware UI: controls hidden/disabled by the matrix with a tooltip reason; delete workspace (owner) with name-typed confirmation and the 7-day billing wind-down note.
scope_out: Billing screens (C089), audit and webhooks (C091), notifications (C090).
build_against: Mock backend (lane C007) generated from OpenAPI for all /v1/workspaces*, invites, projects, settings endpoints, with ETag, 412 `precondition_failed`, 403 `forbidden`, and seat-limit entitlement errors.
interfaces: export function useWorkspace(id: WorkspaceId): {data?: Workspace; etag?: string; update(patch: WorkspacePatch): Promise<void>}
export function can(role: WorkspaceRole, action: WorkspaceAction): boolean  // UI mirror of CT-RBAC matrix only
acceptance: `can()` matches the CT-RBAC workspace matrix for all 5 roles x 10 actions (table-driven test generated from the matrix; includes admin may not change owner role).
Member list paginates with cursor (`limit=50`, `next_cursor`, `has_more`) and loads more on scroll or 'Load more' without duplicates.
PATCH settings sends `If-Match` with the stored ETag; on 412 `precondition_failed` the form shows 'Changed elsewhere' with a refresh-and-reapply action; no silent overwrite.
Creating an invite twice from a double-click sends one request key (same Idempotency-Key) and results in one invite; the response `Idempotency-Replayed: true` is handled without error.
Changing a role as a non-admin (forged) yields 403 `forbidden`; UI shows a danger toast with the CT-ERR text and reverts the select within 300 ms.
Delete workspace and transfer ownership require typing the workspace name; confirm button label repeats the verb ('Delete workspace'); modal has no mascot.
Seat limit reached shows the entitlement banner with a single 'See billing' link, not a modal; axe 0 serious/critical; table keyboard navigation row-by-row.
guardrails: MUST treat `can()` as presentation only; every mutation relies on the server result and handles `forbidden` after optimistic UI.
MUST send Idempotency-Key on invite creation (required: otherwise `idempotency_key_required`) and on transfer-ownership; keys are ULIDs stored only for the life of the dialog.
MUST NOT expose other members' emails to `guest` or `member` roles beyond what the API returns (render only returned fields).
Destructive actions MUST require typed confirmation and MUST NOT auto-dismiss; no mascot in these surfaces.
failure_modes: 429 -> honour Retry-After; disable submit with countdown text.
Entitlement error on invite (seat limit) -> inline banner 'No free seats' with link to billing; no retry.
Workspace deleted elsewhere (404) -> redirect to /workspaces with info toast.
